Late winter has been kind to the desk
Steady Care, Ready Departures

The Companion Animal Travel Desk is moving through a brisk stretch at Aurelia Skyways, and every case is getting the same careful attention. Staff are checking carriers, papers, and comfort notes with a sharp eye, because safety takes priority over speed in every journey. The desk welcomes questions in a warm professional tone, and it is paying off with calmer check-ins and fewer last-minute worries for travelers and pets alike.

Care plans account for species, temperament, and comfort, so each trip is matched to the animal in front of us, not a generic checklist. Small details matter, from a nervous cat to a restless dog, and the team is staying ready to guide each family through the process. Keep sharing updates early, stay alert at the counter, and let us help make the next trip smoother.
